usedFor: Recras holds bookings and customers, and Calendly gets a link from “Create Scheduling Link” when a record is added.

bestTemplate.name: “New Customer” in Recras, then “Create Scheduling Link” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: A new customer is the person you may want to meet, and the action creates a booking link for it.

watchOut: “Update Customer” in Recras fires on every customer update, so using it here can create several links for one person.
